name: Accordion
intent: List of short sections where one opens at a time.
usage: Use Accordion for FAQs or short groups of details the user opens one at a time. Opening one item closes the others. Clicking the open item closes it. See contracts/accordion.json for the full contract.

defaultOpen.note: id of the item that starts open. Omit to start with all closed.

items.note: Two or more. Each id is unique. Keep content short.

useWhen: FAQ or help copy grouped under short titles.
Settings or detail groups the user opens one at a time.
doNot: Do not invent a local Accordion, Collapse or Disclosure.
Do not open more than one item at a time.
Do not use for switching between peer views of the same data.
Do not put a full form inside every panel.
a11y: Each title is a native button with aria-expanded.
The button aria-controls its panel; the panel is a region labeled by the button.
Closed panels are hidden from screen readers.
snippet:
<Accordion
  defaultOpen="hours"
  items={[
    { id: "hours", title: "Hours", content: "Weekdays 9 to 5." },
    { id: "address", title: "Address", content: "Knez Mihailova 1." },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: FAQ
examples.usage: Help copy the user opens one answer at a time. Start with the most asked question open.

items.title: Hours
items.content: Weekdays 9 to 5. Closed on public holidays.

items.title: Parking
items.content: Free parking behind the building for the first two hours.

examples.title: Settings groups
examples.usage: Group related settings under short titles. Start closed so the user sees every group at once.

items.title: Profile
items.content: Name, email and photo shown to your team.

items.title: Billing
items.content: Plan, payment method and invoice email.

items.title: Team
items.content: Invite people and choose what they can see.
